raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 12 arrived with lowercase status values ('posted'/'reversed') and amounts prefixed with '$'. The silver filter `status = 'POSTED'` is case-sensitive, so all 369 batch 12 rows were dropped, which is 347 posted plus 22 reversed. Fixing silver_transactions to match status case-insensitively and strip '$' from amount restores the 347 posted rows, and the gold tables rebuild from it.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.93,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(replace(trim(amount), '$', '') AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE upper(trim(status)) = 'POSTED'"}}
